articles.title: The China Shock in the AI Era
articles.summary: Americans are anxious about artificial intelligence . In the midterm elections , they voted to slow down its expansion. Forty local ballot measures in 10 states promise to tighten restrictions on data-center construction, with overwhelming public support. Measures to limit development of data centers won more than 70% of the vote in 30 of these electoral contests. articles.title: Congress Must Protect the CDC From Politics
articles.summary: Democrats and Republicans in the new Congress will disagree about plenty in health policy. However, they should agree that the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) should be a scientific agency whose judgments hold steady no matter who occupies the White House. In January, Congress will have the chance to write that principle into law. For decades, the scientific independence of America’s public health agencies rested on a bipartisan understanding. articles.title: Fatih Birol: The Energy World Will Never Be the Same As Before the Iran War
articles.summary: For more than a decade, Fatih Birol has been one of the world’s most influential voices in energy markets. As the head of the International Energy Agency (IEA), he advises presidents and energy ministers; CEOs follow his view of the market with careful attention. articles.title: Breaking Down the Ending of Jessica Chastain's Nashville Thriller Heartland
articles.summary: Netflix's Heartland follows Misty Jones ( Jessica Chastain ), a former country music star living in self-imposed exile who returns to Nashville after her niece, an up-and-coming singer named Charlie Heart (Carter Faith), goes missing. As she investigates the disappearance, Misty uncovers a series of suspicious connections involving Charlie's manager, Roy Combs ( Garrett Hedlund ), and a local police detective. articles.title: Inside Salish and Jordan Matter’s Growing Father-Daughter Empire
articles.summary: It’s already 10:27 p.m. on a Saturday night in October when Salish Matter asks gently, “Are we going to start filming soon?” The 16-year-old stands in the aisle of her local Target in Manhattan Beach, Calif., beside her father Jordan Matter. They are dressed almost identically, in jeans and black shirts.
